programs.name: Master of Science in Pharmaceutical Engineering

academic.text: An academic Bachelor's or Master's degree of at least 180 credits and/or 3 years of study in pharmaceutical sciences, bio-science engineering, chemistry, bio-industrial sciences or bioscience engineering technology (biotechnology module).
academic.quote: Students who wish to enrol for the Master of Science in Pharmaceutical Engineering can apply for  the programme if they hold the following diploma: an academic diploma (at least 180 credits and/or 3 years of study) of Bachelor (or Master) of Science in pharmaceutical sciences, bio-science engineering, chemistry, bio-industrial sciences and bioscience engineering technology (module biotechnology).

prerequisites.text: Basic science training in mathematics and/or basic statistics, physics, organic chemistry, biochemistry, inorganic chemistry and analytical chemistry.
prerequisites.quote: International students with similar previous education must be able to demonstrate through their transcripts that they received basic science training in the following fields: (i) Mathematics, and/or basic statistics; (ii) Physics; (iii) Organic chemistry; (iv) Biochemistry; (v) Inorganic chemistry; (vi) Analytical chemistry.
Some lab experiences is required too.
